limits: Three original period1 fresh private desktop Chrome mobile emulations only; no Android/iOS or other campaign/defender/period branch acceptance.
No complete visual-frame inspection or full HD/full native ABI acceptance.
The native synchronous succession boundary is independently recomputed; the later strategy month/random outcomes are observed, not predicted or treated as a pure succession world diff.

Save serialization oracle accepts measured persisted fields, resident queue prefix0..199. Queue200..1999/config/tools are not serialized. Entire recorded loaded.world=saved.world is an actual equality observation for these runs, not proof all fields persist generally.

Fresh pair equality after mutation/reload/load is enforced by runtime assertions; only the original raw pair is retained separately, so no second post-load pair raw value is independently re-read here.

Six negative cases per run are independently checked from before/after full worlds. Held-classic uses clearly recorded public presentation-only setMode API; separate trusted mode tap roundtrip also ran.
No user browser profile or runtime profile content was read. OS cleanup is not independently sampled here; the result cleanup flags are explicitly terminal-runtime reports.
All earlier failed/non-triggered actuals remain historical evidence; this review does not relabel or erase them.

notes: Pre-fix runs prove stale System pointer IDs 4/5/6 survived battle buttons that consumed document capture UP; window capture fixes pairing without clearing held pointers or weakening gates.
Natural retreats without player succession remain rejected/not-covered. No seed/world writes, forceWin or automatic hidden retry.

Two intermediate runs completed actual save and Treat but failed a helper full-world read at the unloaded refreshed title; the corrected preload path is restricted to original TITLE/LOAD owners, with unchanged complete MAP world equality after LOAD.
Original native save only persists the first 200 resident queue entries; recorded full world equality does not imply additional ABI persistence or RNG restoration.
Other periods/capture branches, real defender selection, month/RNG outcomes, Android/iOS devices, performance and full HD remain pending.
